title: CPSC, Crosman Corporation Announce Recall of Air Rifles
summary: The air rifles can discharge unexpectedly when the user closes the barrel, posing a serious risk of injury to consumers and bystanders. Units: 1,500.

title: CPSC, Park Tool USA Announce Recall of Bicycle Floor Pump
summary: The bicycle pump can become over-pressurized with air, forcing the handle to quickly and unexpectedly rise upward, possibly injuring the user. Units: 4,000.

title: CPSC, Pottery Barn Announce Recall to Issue Important Safety Warning for Halloween House Tealight Holders
summary: Using a plastic tealight in the turret may cause the tealight to flare up, presenting a fire hazard. Only metal tealight holders should be used. Units: 5,400.

title: CPSC, Technuity Inc. Announce Recall of Back-Up Power Supply Systems
summary: When used in conjunction with another power protection device, the power supply device can spark, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: 2,100.

title: CPSC, HSN LP and Innova, Inc. Announce Expansion of the Recall of Ultrex Thermal/Double Wall Pans
summary: The non-stick part of the pan can separate forcefully and be propelled when the pan is preheated, used on high heat, or used for frying, deep-frying or braising. This can pose a serious burn hazard from hot oil or food contents spilling onto consumers. Units: 244,000.

title: CPSC, Buck Knives Inc. Announce Recall of Pocket Knives
summary: The black plastic handles of the pocket knives can crack, posing a risk of injury from the blade. Units: 2,000.

title: CPSC, Honda Power Equipment Manufacturing Inc. Announce Recall of Lawnmowers
summary: If the lawnmower strikes an object with sufficient force, the crankshaft can bend. Vibration created by a bent crankshaft can eventually result in a fatigue failure of the Roto-stop™ blade brake control assembly. title: CPSC, John Wiley & Sons Inc. Announce Recall of "Candle and Soap Making For Dummies" Instruction Book
summary: The instructions in the book for making lye combine sodium hydroxide and water in an incorrect order. This could cause the mixture to bubble over, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: 5,400.

title: CPSC, Magic Cabin Announce Recall of Wooden Toy Cars
summary: The wheels on the toy car can come off, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: 600.

title: CPSC, Cybex International Inc. Announce Recall of Treadmills
summary: Fire hazard because of overheating and ignition of dust inside the treadmill's hood. The dust accumulates because of lack of regular maintenance. Units: 33,719.

title: CPSC, Kawasaki Announce Recall of ATVs
summary: The lower front suspension arm can separate from the steering assembly, resulting in a loss of steering control and posing a serious risk of injury to the rider. Units: 75,000.

title: CPSC, Fire Control Instruments Announce Recall for Audio Evacuation Units
summary: The AEU can enter a "sleep" mode, where it does not communicate with the system. When this occurs, audible evacuation signals associated with the failed AEU will not operate and building occupants may not be warned of an emergency. Units: 276.

title: CPSC, Michaels Stores, Inc. Announce Recall of Halloween Candleholders
summary: Because of the lack of ventilation in these ceramic candleholders, the tealights can flare up, posing a risk of burns to consumers. Units: About 165,000.

title: CPSC, Notifier Announce Recall for Fire Alarm Panels
summary: The AEU can enter a "sleep" mode, where it does not communicate with the system. When this occurs, audible evacuation signals associated with the failed AEU will not operate and building occupants may not be warned of an emergency. Units: 6,000.

title: CPSC, Walgreen Co. Announce Recall of Pumpkin Tealight Candleholders
summary: The beads on the candleholders can ignite, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 5,000.

title: CPSC, Neurosmith Announce Recall of Children's Plush Toys
summary: Any of the four plastic button covers can detach, posing a small parts choking hazard to young children. Units: 4,400.

title: CPSC, Russound Inc. Announce Recall to Repair Audio Video Controller/Amplifiers
summary: The Controller/Amplifiers can short circuit and overheat, posing a risk of injury to consumers. Units: 1,200.

title: CPSC, Shindaiwa Inc. Announce Recall of Hedge Trimmers
summary: The fuel cap on the hedge trimmer can leak, posing a fire and burn hazard. Units: 59,200.

title: CPSC, Style Asia Inc. Announce Recall of Cigarette Lighters
summary: The cigarette lighters do not have qualified child resistant mechanisms and pose a fire hazard to children. Units: 3,000 Wristwatch Lighters, and 5,000 Cigarette-shaped Lighters.

title: CPSC, The Sarut Group d/b/a City Limit Announce Recall of Fish-Shaped Cigarette Lighters
summary: The lighters lack the required child resistant mechanisms and can expose children to fire hazards. Units: 3,100.

title: CPSC, Wahl Clipper Corp. Announce Recall of Curling Irons
summary: The electrical insulation in the curling irons may break down, resulting in a possible electric shock and injury to the user. Units: 6,000.

title: CPSC, Pier 1 Imports Announce Recall of Footed Glass Floater Bowl Candleholder
summary: The base of the Footed Glass Floater Bowl candleholder can unexpectedly fall off and cause the glass bowl or base to break, and the broken glass can cause cuts. Units: 65,800.

title: CPSC, Husqvarna Forest and Garden Co. Announce Recall to Repair Lawn Mowers
summary: A loose blade bolt could cause the blade to come loose or the blade adapter to crack, resulting in the blade falling off. Should this condition occur, the operator or a bystander could be injured. Units: 9,900.

title: CPSC, Koyker Manufacturing Announce Recall of Utility Vehicles
summary: Brass gear in the steering sector can break, causing consumers to lose steering capabilities. Units: 350.
